content_sections.heading: About NITR
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Rourkela is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India. It is located at Sector 1, Rourkela, Sundergarh Dist., Odisha. These posts serve the Information Security Education and Awareness project Phase III (Hardware Security), and the funding agency is printed as 4197 - CBSD, MEITY [RBI - 10687701200].

content_sections.text: B.E. / B.Tech. in the CSE/IT/ECE or a related discipline, or MCA, or M.Sc. in an appropriate branch of Science. faq.question: Q1. Is GATE mandatory for the NITR Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: Yes. "Gate Qualified" is printed as an essential qualification, in addition to the degree and the minimum CGPA or marks.

faq.question: Q2. What minimum marks are required?
faq.answer: You need a CGPA of not less than 6.5 in the 10 point scale, or not less than 60% marks in B.E. / B.Tech. or an equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q3. Can MCA or M.Sc. candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes. MCA is accepted, and so is M.Sc. in an appropriate branch of Science. PCM in 11th and 12th Standards is still mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. Which skills are listed as an advantage?
faq.answer: The notice lists work on secure hardware architectures on FPGA platforms, and machine learning and deep learning models for side-channel attack detection, hardware Trojan identification and fault injection resilience.

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. Engagement is purely temporary / contractual and ends with the completion of the project.

faq.question: Q6. Which project will the Project Fellows work on?
faq.answer: They will work on the Information Security Education and Awareness project Phase III (Hardware Security), project code SR/24/CS/021.
